title: Successive discounts

title: Markup
prompt:
A shop buys a bag for 640 baht and marks it up 35% **on cost**.
- Find the selling price.
- Find the markup as a percent of the selling price.
solution:
Markup = 640 × 0.35 = 224.00; selling price = **864.00** baht.

Markup on selling price = 224.00 ÷ 864.00 = **25.93%**.

title: Average daily balance
prompt:
A credit card has a 30-day billing cycle:
- days 1–10: balance 12,000 baht
- days 11–22: balance 9,500 baht
- days 23–30: balance 15,500 baht

The annual rate is 18%. Find the average daily balance and the finance charge (use days/365).

title: Percent change
prompt:
A product's price rises from 1,250 to 1,400 baht, then falls back to 1,250 baht.
- Find the percent increase.
- Find the percent decrease on the way back.
solution:
Increase = (1,400 − 1,250) ÷ 1,250 = 150 ÷ 1,250 = **12.00%**.

Decrease = 150 ÷ 1,400 = **10.71%** (smaller, because the base is bigger).
